name: Owner FAST payment raises the collected amount of the project

steps.text: capital project "Çatı Yalıtımı" with budget 42000.00 has installment 1 accrued
the owner of unit A14 has paid 4000.00 by FAST with description "AHMET YILMAZ DEMIRBAS 1. TAKSIT"
the site manager opens the capital projects segment
the "collected" capital metric shows 4000.00
capital dues paid in the ledger total 4000.00

name: Budget is split by land share without rounding drift

steps.text: the site manager opens the capital projects segment
the manager creates capital project "Asansör Revizyonu" with budget 500000.00 allocated by land share in 3 installments
the project is stored as "ACTIVE" with budget 500000.00 and allocation "BY_LAND_SHARE"
the unit shares shown add up to exactly 500000.00
unit "14" is shown its land share proportion of 500000.00

name: Equal allocation gives every unit the same share

steps.text: the site manager opens the capital projects segment
the manager creates capital project "Kamera Sistemi" with budget 60000.00 allocated equally in 1 installments
every unit is shown an equal share of 60000.00
the project is stored as "ACTIVE" with budget 60000.00 and allocation "EQUAL_PER_UNIT"

name: Disbursement within collected cash updates the reserve

steps.text: capital project "Çatı Yalıtımı" with budget 42000.00 has installment 1 accrued
the owner of unit A14 has paid 4000.00 by FAST with description "AHMET YILMAZ DEMIRBAS 1. TAKSIT"
the site manager opens the capital projects segment
the manager records disbursement "1. Hakediş" of 1000.00 to "Yıldız Yalıtım Ltd."
the disbursement dialog closes
the "disbursed" capital metric shows 1000.00
the "reserve" capital metric shows 3000.00
a single contractor disbursement of 1000.00 is stored

name: Disbursement larger than collected cash is refused

steps.text: the site manager opens the capital projects segment
the manager creates capital project "Asansör Revizyonu" with budget 500000.00 allocated by land share in 1 installments
the manager records disbursement "1. Hakediş" of 120000.00 to "Yıldız Asansör Ltd."
no contractor disbursement is stored

name: Accruing an installment charges owners only

steps.text: the site manager opens the capital projects segment
the manager creates capital project "Çatı Yalıtımı" with budget 90000.00 allocated by land share in 3 installments
the manager accrues installment 1
installment 1 is shown as accrued
one "CAPITAL_DUES" liability per unit is charged to "OWNER" totalling 30000.00
no capital liability is charged to any other debtor
installment 1 is stored as accrued

name: Virman dialog offers the real advance balance of the unit

steps.text: the owner of unit A14 has paid 3500.00 by FAST with description "AHMET YILMAZ AVANS"
the site manager opens the virman dialog in dues management
the virman unit list shows an advance of "₺3.500,00"

name: Owner dashboard shows capital dues separately

steps.text: capital project "Çatı Yalıtımı" with budget 42000.00 has installment 1 accrued
the owner of unit A14 has paid 4000.00 by FAST with description "AHMET YILMAZ DEMIRBAS 1. TAKSIT"
the home owner opens the resident dashboard
the dashboard balance is above 0.00
the capital balance card is shown

name: Capital project is marked as the responsibility of the owner

steps.text: the home owner signs in
the owner responsibility capital badge is shown
